title: CHARACTER_LENGTH (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT CHARACTER_LENGTH(007.0000) AS NumLen, CHARACTER_LENGTH('007.0000') AS NumStringLen
SELECT DISTINCT CHARACTER_LENGTH(Home_State) AS StateLength FROM Sample.Employee
SELECT Name, CHARACTER_LENGTH(Name) AS NameLength FROM Sample.Employee ORDER BY NameLength
SELECT DISTINCT CHARACTER_LENGTH(Notes) AS NoteLen FROM Sample.Employee WHERE Notes IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT CHARACTER_LENGTH(Picture) AS PicLen FROM Sample.Employee WHERE Picture IS NOT NULL
